name: Anantara World Islands Dubai Resort
insider_take: This is Dubai's most exclusive island escape - a luxury resort accessible only by private yacht, offering complete privacy on your own slice of paradise in the Arabian Gulf.
whats_special: Anantara World Islands sits on "The World" - Dubai's ambitious man-made archipelago of 300 islands shaped like a world map. You'll be staying on what represents "Lebanon" on this floating world, with unobstructed views of Dubai's iconic skyline. The resort features overwater villas - a rarity in the Middle East - and is the only resort operating on The World Islands project.
pro_tip: Book the Royal Beach Villa for direct beach access and your own private stretch of pristine white sand. The sunset views from your villa deck are absolutely spectacular and perfect for Instagram-worthy shots.
dont_miss: The resort's signature dining at Qamar restaurant offers Middle Eastern cuisine with panoramic ocean views. Take advantage of the complimentary non-motorized water sports, and don't skip the spa treatments in overwater pavilions. The yacht transfers to and from the mainland are an experience in themselves - time them for sunset if possible.
pros: Exclusive private island location on artificial World Islands archipelago
Overwater villas with direct ocean access and stunning Dubai skyline views
Multiple dining venues including beachfront and overwater restaurants
Comprehensive spa and wellness facilities with traditional treatments
cons: Boat transfer required for mainland access
Premium pricing due to exclusive island location
